photo.query: Rick Ross rapper outside Miami-Dade jail TGK
photo.prompt: dramatic news-style photo of Rick Ross outside a Miami-Dade jail entrance with camera flashes and police lights

slides.headline: Rick Ross left TGK saying “I’m totally innocent”
slides.body: Ross bonded out Thursday after his Miami-Dade booking in a domestic violence case.

photo.query: Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center Miami-Dade jail exterior
photo.prompt: tight nighttime shot of Miami-Dade's Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center entrance with flashing police lights

slides.headline: Police say an ex accused him at a Miami Beach home
slides.body: Police say a woman accused Ross of strangling and hitting her during a domestic dispute at a Miami Beach home.

photo.query: Miami Beach residential street night police car
photo.prompt: Miami Beach residential street at night with a police cruiser parked outside a gated home

slides.headline: The case includes felony battery by strangulation
slides.body: Ross faced a felony battery-by-strangulation charge, along with battery and domestic violence charges.

photo.query: Miami Beach Police Department vehicle night
photo.prompt: Miami Beach police SUV with red and blue lights outside a home at night

slides.headline: Ross is William Leonard Roberts II
slides.body: The rapper, born in Mississippi and raised in Carol City, built his career in South Florida before founding Maybach Music Group.

photo.query: Rick Ross rapper performing concert close up
photo.prompt: close-up concert photo of Rick Ross onstage with a microphone and dark stage lighting

slides.headline: Ross entered a not guilty plea
slides.body: Ross pleaded not guilty after the Miami Beach arrest on battery and domestic violence charges.

photo.prompt: Miami-Dade courthouse exterior with steps, columns and a cloudy afternoon sky

slides.headline: The case moved into court Thursday
slides.body: Ross appeared in court after the arrest, and the case now proceeds through Miami-Dade.

photo.prompt: Miami-Dade courthouse hallway with benches, fluorescent lights and a closed courtroom door

caption:
Rick Ross was booked in Miami-Dade after police say his ex-girlfriend accused him of strangling and hitting her at a Miami Beach home. He bonded out, pleaded not guilty and denied the accusation outside TGK.
